decisions.text: We want the remote to be a universal remote for T_V_s only, not universal across all devices.
We will not include teletext functionality.
The remote should incorporate the corporate colors (grey and yellow) and the slogan 'We put the fashion in electronics'.
We will not include speech recognition due to cost and practicality concerns, despite younger users expressing interest.
We will include a locator function to help find the remote if it is lost.
We will use rechargeable batteries or solar power, and the locator function can be integrated into a charging holder.
We will focus on a one-handed design, not a ball-shaped remote.
We will focus on a design that is user-friendly, with a minimal number of buttons and a user-centric interface.
We will use a scroll wheel for channel selection and other functions, with a click function to confirm selections.
We will design the remote primarily for right-handed users, with consideration for left-handed users through special orders if needed.
We will explore a two-piece remote concept: one for quick zapping (power, volume, channel up/down) and another for more detailed functions.
We will continue to focus on a modern, stylish design that appeals to users and stands out from traditional remotes.
We will simplify the remote by reducing the number of buttons and combining functions where possible.
